gloss: I messed up, I screwed up

definitions.gloss: I messed up, I screwed up, I blew it
definitions.explanation: A casual exclamation acknowledging that one has made a significant mistake or blunder. Past tense of やらかす, almost always used in this past form to react to something that has already gone wrong.

examples.japanese: やらかした！⟦{鍵|かぎ}→鍵：02189_kagi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{中|なか}→中：00654_naka⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{忘|わす}れた→忘れる：00474_wasureru⟧。
examples.english: I messed up! I left my keys inside.

examples.japanese: ⟦{大事|だいじ}→大事：01253_daiji⟧な⟦メール→メール：04435_meeru⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{間違|まちが}えて→間違える：01109_machigaeru⟧⟦{送|おく}っ→送る：00742_okuru⟧ちゃった。やらかした。
examples.english: I accidentally sent an important email to the wrong person. I really messed up.

examples.japanese: 「どうした⟦の→の：09472_no⟧？」「⟦{寝坊|ねぼう}して→寝坊する：16731_nebousuru⟧やらかした。⟦{会議|かいぎ}→会議：00710_kaigi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{遅刻|ちこく}した→遅刻する：22282_chikokusuru⟧」
examples.english: "What happened?" "I overslept and screwed up. I was late for the meeting."

notes:
やらかした is the past tense of ⟦やらかす→やらかす：09375_yarakasu⟧ (to mess up, to commit a blunder). The base form ⟦やらかす→やらかす：09375_yarakasu⟧ exists but is far less common in everyday speech — the past form やらかした is the standard way this word appears, used as a reactive exclamation after realizing a mistake.

USAGE:
- Self-directed: やらかした！ (I messed up!)
- About someone else: ⟦あいつ→あいつ：08267_aitsu⟧、⟦また→また：00969_mata⟧やらかした⟦よ→よ：09475_yo⟧ (That guy screwed up again)
- The mistake is usually significant or embarrassing, not a trivial slip

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦やっ→やる：02980_yaru⟧ちゃった: lighter tone, "oops" — suitable for minor mistakes
- しまった: "oh no" — a broader expression of regret
- やらかした: implies a bigger, more consequential blunder

REGISTER:
Casual. Not appropriate in formal or business settings. In polite speech, ⟦{失敗|しっぱい}→失敗：01636_shippai⟧⟦しました→する：00392_suru⟧ or ⟦ミス→ミス：00285_misu⟧⟦しました→する：00392_suru⟧ would be used instead.
